column3: BootUI 2.4.0 #1600: missing driver metadata (name, version, URL) or failed ORM model discovery emit WARNING diagnostics and leave report status PARTIAL with incomplete coverage; absent ORM models or unconfigured mappers are neutral INFO skip; complete empty inventory does not make datasource partial

SQLAlchemy Inspector get_table_names() queries PostgreSQL relations in a single query without a separate getTableTypes() query or fallback; sharpit only warns of incomplete relation inventory when a dedicated relation_inventory_complete=False signal is present, never on generic truncated or complete=False
Hibernate metadata diagnostic source adapted to SQLAlchemy metadata in Python (neutral INFO on absent models or unconfigured mappers, WARNING on discovery error)

BootUI JDBC driver diagnostic wording adapted to Python database terms (The database driver name was unavailable..., The database driver version was unavailable., The database URL could not be read..., The driver reported no database URL...)
Advisor evidence limitations follow BootUI DatabaseAdvisorScanner.doScan: distinct WARNING and ERROR diagnostics capped at 20, without duplicate datasource scope notes
The dedicated relation_inventory_complete signal has no producer under src/; incomplete PostgreSQL relation inventory is not yet observable
